Figure 2:One training cycle of SteerDistill.(i)Closed-loop teacher steeringguides the frozen student to revise
divergent turns and uses execution feedback to refine the guidance.
Local verification compares the resulting environment transition with that of a
successful teacher reference. On failure, the student retries with refined
guidance from the same pre-error history and state.
Verified corrections are retained, and rollout continues
without guidance.
(ii) To internalize these corrections, the learner receives no guidance and
learns from the steered snapshot’s
predictions at corrected turns and the full-precision teacher’s predictions
elsewhere. Contextcccontains the retained history and response prefix
without steering prompts; only the steered target additionally receivesGG.
The updated student generates the next cycle’s rollouts.
